_about: Batch B2 terms (concepts/roles, topology, control-plane, wire-data, code/connectors-core, code/p2p-py). Owner: writer B2. Reuse ids from core.json, s1.json, s2.json and b1.json; do not redefine them.

afd-world.short: The connector's process group across both roles. The P2P connector orders it [F0..A0..]: FFN ranks first, then attention ranks.
afd-world.long: The GPU connector creates it as the "afd" NCCL group with world size ffn_size + attention_size ({{cite afd_plugin/connectors/gpu/p2p.py:269-276}}).
